scope: Original bounded classification-review dialect; these are local rules, not universal SKOS/FHIR axioms.

invariants.rule: Scheme, release and literal code qualify category equality; labels/scores do not.
Profile restriction preserves identity/unit/slot/meaning and exact parent/release pins.
Allowed sets and cardinality may only narrow.
Incomplete enumerations cannot establish closed membership/exclusion.
Competing targets remain before receiving-profile filtering.
Compound mappings never become pairwise exact migration.
Approval claims require separately supplied exact host acknowledgment.
Historical source conformance does not imply current target eligibility.
Assignment and concept intervals are half-open.
No label-based model identity replacement or package execution.
Direct mode does not traverse mapping chains.
Read context binds exact actor, purpose, Dimension and packet.
Changed mapping bytes invalidate old approval acknowledgment.
Source corrections retain predecessors; conflicting selection is not recency-sorted.
Repeated exact input/build/approval replays identically without new approval.
Unsupported migration/downgrade preserves original evidence and is refused.
Native record belongs to the local Assessment, not to the classified subject.
Nested replay rejects forged results even when ordinary native structure is valid.
A complete correspondence context is required before proposing a unique candidate.
Unknown or unsupported binding semantics never become successful conformance.
Same semantic source coordinate across captures requires identical complete payload; capture envelopes may differ.
Cached ancestors count toward the complete chain bound.
A profile minimum above the supported instance capacity is unsupported.
A public review result must fit as a complete replayable value; no truncation.
